digest.component_or_area: store ensures registry and ticket reducer
propositions: */.archived and */.write.lock files are tracked in the tickets branch despite being in .gitignore, causing git status to report false working-tree deletions and breaking the strict head check in tracker_head_sha

An ensure unit untrack-runtime-markers removes tracked runtime marker files from git index (worktree copies untouched) via batched git rm --cached in a single commit, with zero commits on re-run (idempotent)

Reader self-heals missing .archived markers by re-materializing them when the compiled state indicates archived but the marker file is absent, restoring fast-path cache on peers merging the untrack commit
Untracking commit merges cleanly into peer clones with existing marker files in the worktree; git deletion during merge leaves status clean and excludes archived tickets from list output
